## Design

### 2026-10-31: Worked on the schematic for the project in KiCAD. Settled on a basic ESP 32 board that I already had and did some research on the different types of displays. Think I'm going to go for a TFT display t

**1.5h**

Worked on the schematic for the project in KiCAD. Settled on a basic ESP 32 board that I already had and did some research on the different types of displays. Think I'm going to go for a TFT display to have some pixel animations and display info about the weather

### 2026-11-01: I finished up the KiCAD schematic and PCB layout. Took me a bit longer than expected since I had to settle on the exact ESP32 dimensions and wasn't sure how to do that. Eventually though I figured it

**4.8h**

I finished up the KiCAD schematic and PCB layout. Took me a bit longer than expected since I had to settle on the exact ESP32 dimensions and wasn't sure how to do that. Eventually though I figured it out and did all the wiring. I also wrote the firmware for ESP32. It will get weather data from the Open Meteo based on your location and display some basic info on the display. The two buttons can either refresh the data or automatically change the screen to some different designs. Right now it's rather limited so I'll need to add more intricate UIs and also build an enclosure before submitting.

### 2026-11-01: Designed an enclosure to house the PCB and give a window to view the display interact with buttons. I think i can just 3D print this and I added screw holes to be able to take the lid on a off. I also

**4h**

Designed an enclosure to house the PCB and give a window to view the display interact with buttons. I think i can just 3D print this and I added screw holes to be able to take the lid on a off. I also reworked the firmware to display different animations and UI elements the show the weather and also automatically update the weather occasionally. I also had to rework the Open Meteo call which required reading through some docs and a few reddit thread but I think I figured it out in the end.
